ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (28) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Совершенствование» (sovershenstvovanie) is 'perfecting', and Lamennais's «преображаться» / «преобразоваться» (preobrazhat'sya / preobrazovat'sya) are both 'be transformed'; pronouns for God stay lowercase as in the source. «Иосиф Мадзини» (Iosif Madzini) is Giuseppe Mazzini, and in Mazzini «время знания и открытия» (vremya znaniya i otkrytiya), which takes a plural verb, is read as 'time, knowledge, and discoveries'.

Source observation: [8] «время знания и открытия лишь расширяют его границы» (vremya znaniya i otkrytiya lish' rasshiryayut ego granitsy): the plural verb points to a missing comma («время, знания и открытия», 'time, knowledge, and discoveries'); translated in that sense.
